description: This file is a shell script that sets up a git repository with a criss-cross merge scenario, creating multiple branches and conflicts to test the recursive merge functionality, culminating in a test that verifies the merge does not cause a segmentation fault.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with setup commands for a git repository involving multiple branches and conflicts.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command that is expected to fail, used here to intentionally cause merge conflicts.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
